column1: # STEPS.tsv -- THE DESIGN-PLAN skills-complete STEP TABLE (the cio, 2026-11-07, on Lon's word in the cio's window 09:1x, verbatim: "I suspect you'll need to fully scrutinze the set of skill files, their granularity, their completeness and accuracy. Scanning what we've been doing with the fleet for the last 2-3 months should show what all the problems are and make a list and fix all the problems." / "A great resource is the gitihub comment history." / "Do we have skill files partitioned properly. Are they tied properly to what triggers them when they are needed and no when they are not needed?"; the design text in .github/skills/fleet-bus/reference.md section 9; the three audits of 2026-11-07 09:2x-09:4x (the trigger map, the accuracy census, the three-month history) are its baseline).

# harness/scripts/test_design_skills_complete_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N runs the step's PROBE (column 5, one bash command run from S4E_HOME with a 600 s budget): rc 0 GREEN, rc 1 RED, rc 2 could not measure. Every probe reads the skills and the live tree (util_skill_refs_census.py, s4e_skill_gate.py --judge and --self-test, the skills' own text); a step reads RED until its mechanism exists and GREEN only while the skills meet it; no probe is satisfied by a deletion alone.

# THE INSTRUMENTS: harness/scripts/util_skill_refs_census.py (--check, --descriptions, --tables, --self-test; the allow list harness/scripts/SKILL_REFS_ALLOW.tsv; a hand instrument, never a wired gate: Lon 2026-11-07 10:0x), harness/scripts/s4e_skill_gate.py (the trigger table and its --self-test and --judge), .github/scripts/propagate_skills.sh, .github/scripts/propagate_seat_digests_cto_484.py.
# Columns: step, slug, executor (haiku = a worker's row; cio = the designer's own partition work), depends (steps), probe.

column5: python3 -I harness/scripts/util_skill_refs_census.py --self-test > /dev/null && python3 -I harness/scripts/util_skill_refs_census.py --check | grep -E '^SKILL_REFS files=[0-9]+ refs=[0-9]+ missing=[0-9]+'

python3 -I harness/scripts/s4e_skill_gate.py --self-test > /dev/null && python3 -I harness/scripts/s4e_skill_gate.py --judge Edit "$S4E_HOME/harness/scripts/s4e_msg.sh" /nonexistent 2>&1 | grep -q fleet-bus && python3 -I harness/scripts/s4e_skill_gate.py --judge Edit /home/resources/postoffice/MODE /nonexistent 2>&1 | grep -q fleet-bus && python3 -I harness/scripts/s4e_skill_gate.py --judge Edit "$S4E_HOME/harness/scripts/lib_slots.sh" /nonexistent 2>&1 | grep -q shared-box && python3 -I harness/scripts/s4e_skill_gate.py --judge Edit "$S4E_HOME/harness/designs/fleet_queue/STEPS.tsv" /nonexistent 2>&1 | grep -q design-plans && python3 -I harness/scripts/s4e_skill_gate.py --judge Bash "cd $S4E_HOME/SCRIP && sed -i s/a/b/ src/lower/lower_icon.c" /nonexistent 2>&1 | grep -q lowering && ! python3 -I harness/scripts/s4e_skill_gate.py --judge Edit "$S4E_HOME/harness/scripts/s4e_msg.sh" /nonexistent 2>&1 | grep -q 'CLAUDE.md THE SKILL TABLE'
python3 -I harness/scripts/util_skill_refs_census.py --descriptions | grep -E '^SKILL_DESCRIPTIONS skills=[0-9]+ total_chars=[0-9]+ over_cap=0 gated_unmarked=0'

[ "$(grep -lE '200[- ]column' .github/skills/*/SKILL.md | grep -v scrip-c-code | wc -l)" = 0 ] && [ "$(grep -l 'MemoryHigh' .github/skills/*/SKILL.md | grep -v shared-box | wc -l)" = 0 ] && [ "$(grep -l 'a deletion satisfies' .github/skills/*/SKILL.md | grep -v gates-and-witnesses | wc -l)" = 0 ] && [ "$(grep -l 'an HQ cannot' .github/skills/*/SKILL.md | wc -l)" = 0 ] && grep -q 'THE LADDER' .github/skills/fleet-bus/SKILL.md && [ "$(grep -l 'THE LADDER' .github/skills/*/SKILL.md | grep -v fleet-bus | wc -l)" = 0 ]

test -s .github/skills/seat-conduct/SKILL.md && grep -q 'pkill' .github/skills/seat-conduct/SKILL.md && grep -qi 'orphan' .github/skills/seat-conduct/SKILL.md && grep -q '/tmp/s4e/<seat>' .github/skills/seat-conduct/SKILL.md && grep -qi 'one process per' .github/skills/seat-conduct/SKILL.md && grep -qi 'alternates' .github/skills/seat-conduct/SKILL.md && grep -qi 'INSTRUMENT LAWS' .github/skills/gates-and-witnesses/reference.md && grep -qi 'MEASURE AND CURE' .github/skills/gates-and-witnesses/reference.md
n=$(for s in $(ls .github/skills); do grep -lq -- "$s" /home/claude_*/CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING $s; done | grep -c MISSING); [ "$n" = 0 ] && ! grep -q 's4e_msg.sh check' CLAUDE.md
python3 -I harness/scripts/util_skill_refs_census.py --tables | grep -E '^SKILL_TABLES plans=[0-9]+ plans_missing=0 verbs=[0-9]+ verbs_missing=0'

for n in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9; do bash harness/scripts/test_design_skills_complete_steps.sh --step $n > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "step $n not green"; exit 1; }; done; [ -z "$(find .github/skills -name SKILL.md -size +16k)" ]
